faq_heading: Coquitlam Condos for Sale: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built from the boards' September 2026 statistics, the monthly SnapStats figures and Jared's MLS® closed sales (Nov 2025 to Oct 2026). No live feed filtered to this home type yet.

Coquitlam condos for sale: apartment-style homes in strata buildings. The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® benchmark for apartments (condos) in Coquitlam was $640,100 in September 2026 (-7.3% over a year). Before you offer, read the strata documents: the depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees.
Coquitlam condos sold, November 2025 to October 2026

768 condos sold in Coquitlam with a median price of $613,450 (the middle half sold between $505,750 and $705,000), taking a median of 24 days to sell at 97.4% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $769 per square foot, a median year built of 2015 and a median strata fee of $432 a month.

The benchmark is the board’s modelled price for a typical home of this type, not an average of sales. The index sets January 2005 at 100. Changes are as published; the text below calls a change a rise or fall only at 1.5% or more.

blocks.text: Coquitlam: the apartments (condos) benchmark was $640,100 in September 2026. Over the past year it fell 7.3%; over three months it fell 2.1%; over the last month it was little changed (-0.9%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move). Longer term, over 3 years it fell 12.3%; over 5 years it rose 1.7%; over 10 years it rose 59.8%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Condos and townhomes are one line in the reports.

blocks.text: Before you buy condos in Coquitlam
Jared checks these with you on the exact address before you write an offer:

faq.q: What did condos in Coquitlam sell for?
faq.a: 768 condos sold in Coquitlam between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $613,450.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Coquitlam?
faq.a: The median was 24 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.4% of the last list price (6% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos in Coquitlam sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 768 condos that sold in Coquitlam went for between $505,750 and $705,000, around a median of $613,450.

faq.q: Do condos in Coquitlam sell above asking price?
faq.a: 6% of the 768 condos sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.4% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos in Coquitlam?
faq.a: Of the 768 sales, 767 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $432.

faq.q: How old are the condos that sold in Coquitlam?
faq.a: The median year built was 2015 for the 768 condos sold in Coquitlam.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos in Coquitlam usually have?
faq.a: The median condo that sold in Coquitlam had 2 bedrooms, from the 768 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Which Coquitlam communities sold the most condos?
faq.a: By number sold: Coquitlam West (389), North Coquitlam (195), New Horizons (59), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Which Coquitlam buildings sold the most condos?
faq.a: By number sold: The Oaks (16), Precidia (15), Lakeside Terrace (14), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a condo in Coquitlam?
faq.a: The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for apartments (condos) in Coquitlam was $640,100 in September 2026, a modelled price for a typical home and not an average of sales.

faq.q: Did condo prices fall in Coquitlam?
faq.a: Over the past year the benchmark fell 7.3%. Over three months it fell 2.1%. A change under 1.5% is not described as a rise or fall.

faq.q: Is Coquitlam a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in Coquitlam had a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market, and condos and townhomes 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos are for sale in Coquitlam?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the condos in Coquitlam that match what you want.
